essence: Two found faults, not fixed: TaskDirs.list() looks only two folders deep, so the Dashboard stall check and TaskLoop can't see 322 child tasks; and Servex/asks/tasks.js and Agents.js decide "landed" differently, so 17 landed tasks show as stalled.

Sheet hand-off proof: a spoken "file a task" on a page reaches the page's feed in ~7 s, but session-smart.md rule 4b only writes an ai/log.jsonl line (dir_log), so no folder appears in the module's tasks/ home. One edit in 4b (item call into <page>tasks/, then the dir_log line for the feed) fixes it; exact wording in edit-session-smart.md.
